review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent expectation for this pending-decision case. Repository identity, base commit, paired case, REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, and implementation-owner binding agree with the original specification. The source-manifest digest is a separately presented fingerprint, not asserted here to equal the release source digest. I rely on the Service's stated mechanical binding of digests to saved inputs; I did not recompute hashes, execute code, inspect candidates, or provide human attestation. This approval concerns the independent Gold expectation, not permission to run, assign, or release work, and does not resolve DEC-001 or treat any fixed hypothetical input as a human Decision.
